name: Latin Antique 1889
designer: Unidentified in the consulted historical specimen
description: Broad display letters with tapered serifs, open round bowls and a lightly contrasted historical lowercase.
observed: Directly traced characters: 012345679ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUXacdefgiklmnorstuvwy. Printed page 139, PDF page 145. Larger impressions anchor the master; smaller optical sizes supply additional characters. Crops are retained for separately labelled small-source reconstructions as well.
reconstructed: Inferred companion letters and figures: Zbjqxz. Punctuation and remaining symbols are new project drawings. Both historical cases are retained. Spacing and harmonisation of optical sizes are modern choices. The 1889 suffix dates the source, not a claim of first release. Characters redrawn in place of coarse smaller-size traces: 8VWYhp; see companions.json for the construction of each.

sources.title: Specimen book from the Boston type foundry (1889), Latin Antique; printed p. 139, one-based PDF page 145, Internet Archive leaf 145
sources.rights: 1889 US publication, public domain under the maximum historical 95-year term. Library of Congress scan hosted by Internet Archive; retained institutional metadata says the Library is unaware of copyright restrictions. Original native JP2 leaf; no modern digital typeface used.

revival.author: Harold Lehmann
revival.notes: Reviewed transcriptions and exact native crops are retained in source/rows.json, selections.json and tracing.json. New companions are recorded separately with construction notes. Ordinary cap bodies and baseline slope are measured independently for each row. Optical-size differences are retained and reconstructions are explicitly labelled.
